question: Does processing the lower-uncertainty sensor first reduce crossing identity changes, and what does it cost under false alarms and degradation?
primary_metric: crossing ID switches under exact-time 10 m matching; lower is better
comparison_policy: Both methods receive identical observations and parameters except sensor order. Per-source per-seed and arithmetic mean/sample standard deviation; no pooling across cases. Recorded Laura lacks independent truth and receives only truth-free diagnostics. Runtime descriptive. The crossing ID-switch metric is ambiguous at near-coincident truth positions and must be interpreted alongside continuity diagnostics.
